milestones.title: Core: lexer, parser, evaluator, GC, CLI, harness
milestones.goal: Working interpreter for the core language (values, tables, closures, control flow, operators, error/pcall, minimal base lib, print), GC, CLI with exit codes, Makefile, ./lua launcher and test runner.

milestones.title: Language completeness
milestones.goal: Metamethods, 5.5 global/const/close declarations, goto, coroutines (ucontext), detailed runtime error messages with variable names, error levels, xpcall.

milestones.title: string library
milestones.goal: Complete string library: patterns, format, pack/unpack, string metatable.

milestones.title: Remaining libraries and base
milestones.goal: base (load/require/dofile/select...), table, math, utf8, os, io, package, debug minimum.

milestones.title: Hardening, performance, docs
milestones.goal: Benchmarks, GC stress, robustness limits, manual examples, README, full test-suite green.
